items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: George Wein William somehow got his money fucking face in it and made a concert out of it without letting me know.

ctx.x: (Inaudible.) No, no, Town Hall was a not as far as my part was concerned. failure. As far as the promoters who put the concert on, they started rushing me to do it and make it a concert. It was supposed to have been an open recording session. Town Hall was supposed to have been where -- like I told them, I saw Duke Ellington when he first joined Columbia Records, in the theater, and they were recording. And they put all the equipment in this big theatre. And people found out about the recording session, so people…
